weights_source: Institut National de la Statistique (INS), 'Indice National Harmonisé des Prix à la Consommation (INHPC)', monthly note for June 2026 (Note_INHPC_Juin_2026_Guinee_V1.pdf), weight column of the table by consumption function (out of 10,000). The same weights are printed in the May 2026 note (Tableau 2 'Pondérations et variations par fonction'). Base 2019 = 100, UEMOA-harmonised method, weights from the 2019 Harmonised Survey on Household Living Conditions (EHCVM). Published: food 3,930; alcohol and tobacco 66; clothing 749; housing 461; furnishings 326; health 368; transport 1,078; communication 648; recreation 143; education 100; restaurants and hotels 1,683; miscellaneous 449. The twelve published weights add up to 10,001 (rounding), so the 13 values below total 100.01. Mapping COICOP 1999 → 2018: functions I–XI carried one to one, communication becomes 08. No sub-weights of 'Biens et services divers' (12.5 insurance, 12.6 financial services) are published, so all of 1999-12 goes to 2018-13 and 2018-12 is set to 0. Group weights not published.
title_fr: Indice expérimental des prix à la consommation
